profile.headline: ML Engineer @ Capital One
profile.summary:
Masters in CS with a focus in Machine Learning. Experience in ETL training pipelines and backend engineering. My interests lie in machine learning, backend/cloud development, UX accessibility, privacy preserving data analytics, data engineering, and solutions architecture.

In my spare time, I like watching and talking about films, playing pickup soccer and volleyball with friends, and cooking.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Working on a transformer based ensemble model and live decision engine API, with my particular roles being in machine learning engineering with PyTorch, Kubeflow, and SnowFlake.

My work resulted in a 100x speed up in our data engineering pipelines, improved data scientist onboarding through a shared experimentation workspace, provided cross team knowledge transfers of findings, and facilitated parallelized training systems.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked as a backend software engineer and AWS solutions architect on a company-wide critical internal data streaming platform that used a variety of tools such as Kafka, EMR, Fargate, and S3. 

I developed a data streaming pathway and endpoint that improved throughput by 16x, enabled an entire segment of the company to onboard to our tool, and made managed data publishing to managed auditable platforms completely deterministic with the lowest latency possible.

In addition, I also managed and expanded a suite of end to end system monitoring and platform testing tools, which allowed our service to achieve the highest internal production stability rating, and gave confidence for developers to do continuous deployments.

positions.title: Technology Intern
positions.description: Transitioned over 100 pipelines to an enterprise scheduler through the development of a Python migration app. Saved months of manual work and reduced risk of bugs by developing a modular base pipeline. Documented a standardized JSON configuration for future schedulers to generate workflows with.
positions.insights: Skills: AWS Lambda · Python (Programming Language) · GitHub · Bash · Amazon Simple Notification Service (SNS) · JSON

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Created a B2B dashboard using React, Material UI, and Jest to modernize a legacy application. Experimented with sentiment analysis and topic classification to gather actionable insight on customer survey responses using Jupyter Notebooks and sklearn. Created a reusable React component that implements the Master-Detail pattern.

positions.title: Enterprise Technology Intern
positions.description: Created a feature in a CodeceptJS automation testing project that enabled developers to test locally. Contributed bug fixes and assisted in refactoring the automation test suite for upcoming features. Added features in Java to a future internal product, added features to the team Grafana dashboard, and updated the team documentation website in Markdown.

positions.title: Experience Coordinator
positions.description: I helped prepare and teach workshops both before and at the 2019 Fall HackUTD. I created and hosted a workshop on Azure DevOps, I brought in and coordinated a workshop with an industry contact, I helped to teach at other workshops our team had run, and I helped handle check-in and booths at the event.

positions.title: Program Development Intern
positions.description: Developed multiple single page applications using Vue.js, Vuex, Vuetify, and AWS, with unit testing in Jest. Created a scheduling application using Vue.js so that agents could manage their appointments. Assisted in teaching other employees Vue.js to aid in a team technology transition.

positions.title: Water Safety Instructor
positions.description: Taught swimming classes from beginner through advanced levels, to children and adults, along with helping coach the Piranhas swim team

projects.title: UTD Senior Design Project
projects.description: Created a single page application using Vue.js, AWS Lambdas in Python, and AWS DynamoDB to streamline the Analytic Hierarchy Process. Led team discussions with the project sponsor in order to capture requirements and estimate a project timeline. Coordinated team software development.

patents.title: SYSTEMS AND METHODS FOR DISTRIBUTED NETWORK ACCESS CONTROL
patents.description: Developed an ML-driven access governance framework integrating Open Policy Agent and a human feedback workflow to enforce just-in-time zero trust access, particularly in scenarios with low predictive confidence. Leveraged expertise in business process automation and machine learning product management to enhance security controls and automate access decisions across distributed networks.

organizations.name: The Drawing Sessions
organizations.description: I handled finances, created the bank account, managed documents and passwords, and helped brainstorm ideas for the club.
